test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which among the following companies fired about 300 employees under allegations of moonlighting in September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Wipro fired 300 employees for moonlighting.
 
• The IT company could have sacked these employees after finding out about their second job through UAN numbers. 
 
• Wipro chairman Rishad Premji said the company has no place for employees working with rivals. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Wipro Limited is a multinational corporation headquartered in Bangalore, India. **

 
 
• It is a global information technology, consulting, and business process services company that provides solutions to various industries, including banking, finance, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, and telecommunications.
 
• Wipro was founded in **1945 by M.H. Premji** as a manufacturer of vegetable and refined oils. In the 1980s, Wipro shifted its focus to IT services and software development. 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Mindtree Limited is a global technology consulting and services company headquartered in Bangalore, India.**

 
 
• 
 
The company provides end-to-end services in the areas of cloud, data analytics, digital transformation, enterprise application development, testing, infrastructure management, and engineering services to clients across various industries, including banking, financial services, insurance, retail, consumer packaged goods, and manufacturing.

 
 
• 
 
Mindtree was founded in** 1999 **by ten industry professionals, including Ashok Soota, Subroto Bagchi, and Krishnakumar Natarajan, with an initial focus on the software development services market.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Amazon India is a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., the world's largest online retailer.**

 
 
• 
 
Amazon launched its operations in India in **2013,** and since then, it has grown rapidly to become one of the largest e-commerce platforms in the country.

 
 
• 
 
Amazon India offers a wide range of products, including books, electronics, clothing, beauty products, and household items, among others. The company has also introduced various services, such as Amazon Prime, which offers free and fast delivery, streaming of movies and TV shows, and exclusive deals and discounts to its subscribers.

 
 
 
 
• **Microsoft India is a subsidiary of Microsoft Corporation, a multinational technology company headquartered in Redmond, Washington, USA**.
 
 
• Microsoft India was established in **1990.**
 
• Microsoft India has established various innovation centers and labs to support research and development in emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, and the internet of things.
 
• The company has also launched various initiatives to promote digital literacy and skills development in India, including the Microsoft India AI School, which offers free online courses in artificial intelligence and machine learning.
